{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Merino wool coat in charcoal grey (#3e4246), straight cut, knee length, woven with a dense weave for wind protection.
Cashmere-blend turtleneck sweater in soft oat (#e8e3d9), relaxed fit, hip length, fine-gauge knit for insulation without bulk.
High-waisted wool trousers in slate blue (#5b6b7b), tailored straight leg, full length, heavy-weight fabric to resist snow and moisture.
Leather ankle boots in black (#0a0a0a), rounded toe, mid-calf shaft, rubber lug sole with oil-resistant finish for salted streets.
A thin leather belt in cognac (#8f5e43) at the natural waist defines the silhouette under the coat layers.
This outfit works perfectly because the heavy wool trousers and insulated sweater provide necessary warmth against -10°C frost while remaining breathable enough for a brisk twenty-minute walk. The dark, neutral palette of charcoal, oat, and slate creates a professional yet comfortable look suitable for a morning commute in snowy conditions. Sturdy ankle boots with deep treads ensure safety on icy, salted roads without sacrificing style or comfort during the daily journey to work."}
